title: Slow 4G Data Speed Complaint
content:
# Call Transcript: Slow 4G Data Speed Complaint

**Document ID:** TRX_005
**Category:** C09 — Data Services & Speed
**Department:** Network
**Customer Scope:** all
**Last Updated:** 2026-06-26
**Version:** 1.0
**Source Authority:** Internal Knowledge Base
**Channel:** Voice (Call Centre)

---
## Conversation

Agent: NovaTel technical support, this is Divya.
Customer: My internet has been really slow the past two days.
Agent: I'm sorry to hear that. Could you run a speed test from Network > Speed Test in the app and tell me the result?
Customer: It shows 0.8 Mbps.
Agent: Thank you. Let me check your data usage... I see you've crossed your plan's daily high-speed data limit, so Fair Usage Policy has capped your speed for today. This resets at midnight.
Customer: Oh I didn't realise that.
Agent: No problem — you can also purchase a Data Booster pack from the app for immediate high-speed data if you need it now.
Customer: I'll do that, thanks!

Agent: Before we close this, can I just confirm the resolution has fully addressed your concern?
Customer: Yes, that's sorted now, thank you.
Agent: Perfect. I've added a note to your account and you'll also receive a confirmation SMS shortly.

## Diagnostic Notes (Internal)

- Identity verified via registered number and OTP.
- Relevant backend status checked before providing resolution timeline.
- Case closed after customer confirmation; escalated only if unresolved beyond the stated SLA.

## Escalation

This case was resolved on the first contact.

No directly linked documents are recorded for this item; refer to the relevant department for further guidance.
